digest.component_or_area: live Jira Data Center harness / provenance assertion
propositions: The provenance test assertion scans json.dumps(ticket) for the raw Jira key (e.g. 'RBJNAZV-1') but the local ticket id is lowercased by _jira_key_to_local_id (producing 'jira-rbjnazv-1'), so a case-sensitive substring match cannot succeed

The ticket payload created by _inbound_create_write_create_event does not carry the raw Jira key directly; it appears only as a title fallback when summary is absent, so tickets with summaries do not carry the key at all
The DC-to-local correspondence is recorded in the binding store, not in the ticket JSON, but the current assertion does not verify the binding
The test cannot distinguish between 'ticket was created correctly' and 'ticket was not created' because the assertion targets an output shape the inbound path does not produce
The fix must assert exact id match via _jira_key_to_local_id(remote_key) and additionally verify the binding store maps the local id to remote_key
